# Scooping Grasping with Robotic Hand (with Diffusion Policy Rollouts)

> A research project by Seunghwan Um (엄승환 / rush / r-ush), Tae Hyun Bae, and Prof. Hyouk Ryeol Choi at Sungkyunkwan University.

## Overview

This project presents diffusion policy rollouts and grasping data collection with an AIDIN Robotics hand. The page includes final rollout and combined data collection videos, with English and Korean text.

## Page Sections

1. **Main Demo**: Diffusion policy rollout for black object grasping.
2. **Data Collection**: Compliance control absorbs contact impacts to reduce operator workload and simplify data collection.
3. **Principle**: Original scooping and book grasping videos showing compliant surface contact.
4. **Comparison**: Scooping with and without compliance control.
5. **Additional Technique**: Fingertip force feedback compensates for the hand's low mechanical stiffness. Fingertip wrenches are transformed into the wrist frame and combined with the wrist force/torque sensor reading as input to the manipulator's compliance controller.
